title: F-01 — error end event WITHOUT any error boundary / event subprocess: what does Zeebe 8.5 do?

matrix.docs89: 8.9 docs: a BPMN error that is not caught by a boundary event or error event sub-process raises an incident on the element that threw the error; the instance stays alive (the scope is not terminated) so an operator can resolve/retry the incident
matrix.ours: ошибка не поймана → элемент error-end остаётся в ERROR, на него поднимается ОТКРЫТЫЙ инцидент, инстанс жив (completed_at пуст), resolve ПЕРЕИСПОЛНЯЕТ элемент (новая попытка → снова ERROR + новый открытый инцидент) — не тихое закрытие

_help.observeJobTypes: Job types polled after the start; empty = the process has no worker task by design.
_help.expectIncident: The scenario expects the broker to raise an incident (checked via the broker's incident counters).
_help.waitMs: How long to wait for the incident to be raised before sampling the counters.
